title: Maritime Domain Awareness Market and Capability Assessments for the Department of Homeland Security
summary_en: To help the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) improve maritime domain awareness (MDA), the authors assess commercial technologies and DHS components’ capabilities, and they provide recommendations for optimizing DHS’s MDA capabilities.
title_cn: Maritime Domain Awareness Market and Capability Assessments for the Department of Homeland Security
